recs.stt: Tesla announces new Model 3 production plans
recs.x:
Take a look at that Mercedes assembly line. Note all the custom fixtures required, many with sensor and actuators attached. All those have to be designed, built, tested, and run through enough cycles that they behave reliably. One failure stops the whole line.
